items.translation: 一个匹配的方法，或者如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Default is a SimpleTypeConverter. Can be overridden with any TypeConverter implementation, typically a pre-configured SimpleTypeConverter or a BeanWrapperImpl instance.
items.translation: 默认值为一个SimpleTypeConverter。可以使用任何 TypeConverter 实现进行覆盖，通常是预配置的 SimpleTypeConverter 或 BeanWrapperImpl 实例。

items.source: Can be cast to PropertyEditorRegistry if direct access to the underlying PropertyEditors is desired (provided that the present TypeConverter actually implements the PropertyEditorRegistry interface).
items.translation: 可以转换为PropertyEditorRegistry，如果希望直接访问底层的 PropertyEditors（前提是当前的 TypeConverter 确实实现了 PropertyEditorRegistry 接口）。

items.source: Called if no explicit TypeConverter has been specified. The default implementation builds a SimpleTypeConverter. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 如果未显式指定 TypeConverter，则调用此方法。默认实现构建一个 SimpleTypeConverter。可在子类中重写。

items.source: Typically used in conjunction with the default SimpleTypeConverter; will work with any TypeConverter that implements the PropertyEditorRegistry interface as well.
items.translation: 通常与默认SimpleTypeConverter配合使用；只要 TypeConverter 实现了 PropertyEditorRegistry 接口，它也能与之协同工作。
